permission_rules.trigger_point: User explicitly taps 'Remind me' on a scheduled departure

pre_permission_dialog.title: Enable Departure Reminders
pre_permission_dialog.body: O-TRAVELZ will send a local notification before your bus leaves. Reminders are calculated locally from published timetables.

android_behavior.api_level_gte_33: Contextually requests POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission upon tap
android_behavior.api_level_lt_33: Creates notification channel 'TRAVEL_REMINDERS'; permission granted at install time
android_behavior.denied_flow: Dismisses calmly; displays non-intrusive snackbar explaining reminder could not be set without notification permission; offers action to open system App Settings

ios_behavior.request_timing: Invoked on first tap of 'Remind me'
ios_behavior.denied_flow: In-app toast indicates notifications disabled in iOS Settings
